resources.string: A chat model tidies the text before it is typed.
It fixes punctuation, filler words and mis-hearings, and writes in each app\'s style. If the cleanup fails or changes too much, the dictation goes in as recognized.
For every app, before an app\'s own instruction.
Tone and form only, e.g. \"write numbers as digits\". The fixed rules come first: the cleanup never translates, answers, or changes what you said, whatever this says.

Shown for the As spoken style. Each app\'s style and own instruction take their place at the end, the dictation\'s language is named when it is known, and %1$d worked examples follow before the dictation. The prompt is sent in English.
Add a server under Speech recognition (Tinfoil, Groq, OpenAI or your own) to use one of its models.
Set this server up first (address, key).
%1$s offers no cleanup model right now.
The recognized text leaves the phone for the cleanup - your recording does not. Dictations are labelled with where the text went.
When the server can\'t take a recording.
No connection, a timeout or a server down: the speech recognition chosen here recognizes the recording instead. Never one less private than the one it stands in for.
%1$s runs on this phone, so there is no server to fail. This applies once you recognize with a server.
%1$s is less private than %2$s, so it never takes over from it - a failed dictation stays failed.

While you dictate, the model on the phone already recognizes the recording in parts. If the server fails, or takes much longer than usual, the text from the phone is used at once instead of the whole recording being recognized afterwards.
Prepare on the phone while you speak
Uses the phone\'s processor and battery while you dictate. Only with a downloaded model.
If the server takes much longer than usual, the text from the phone is used.
e.g. use \"du\", sign with my first name
Off - as recognized, like every app
This app\'s own cleanup is not ready - the default is used.
This app\'s own cleanup is not ready - no cleanup.
Without a cleanup the style is not applied - the text goes in as recognized.
Speech recognition on the phone only
Each app gets the text in its own style.
Only apps with a model of their own are tidied.
The cleanup chosen under Settings → Cleanup writes in each app\'s style, unless an app has a model of its own. Apps without a style get the text tidied as spoken.
For the other apps, pick a cleanup under Settings → Cleanup.
Pick one under Settings → Cleanup - a model on Tinfoil, Groq, OpenAI or your own server - or one for a single app on its page. Until then the text goes in as recognized.
